cancelNote.description: A message to send with cancellation notifications.

noShow.description: Whether the appointment was a no show, settable by admins.

actions.description: Check if a specific datetime is available for an appointment type.
actions.name: check-availability-times

datetime.description: Date and time to check availability for. Must be parsable by strtotime. Example: "2026-06-25T09:00:00+0300"

appointmentTypeID.description: ID of the appointment type to check. Example: 94517100

calendarID.description: ID of the calendar to check. If omitted, checks any available calendar. Example: 14209019

actions.description: Verify a certificate or coupon code.
actions.name: check-certificate

certificate.description: The certificate code to check. Example: "BFB0E13E"

appointmentTypeID.description: The appointment type ID to check. Example: 94517100

email.description: An optional email address to check if the certificate is valid for. Example: "client@example.com"

valid.description: Whether the certificate is valid for the given appointment type.

productID.description: Product ID associated with the certificate. Example: 1

orderID.description: Order ID associated with the certificate. Example: null

appointmentTypeIDs.description: Appointment type IDs the certificate applies to. Example: [1]

name.description: Name of the certificate. Example: "5 Small Builds"

email.description: Email address associated with the certificate. Example: ""

remainingCounts.description: Remaining usage counts per appointment type. Example: { "1": 5 }

remainingMinutes.description: Remaining minutes on the certificate. Example: null

expiration.description: Expiration date of the certificate. Example: null

error.description: Error message if the certificate is invalid.

datetime.description: Required date and time for the appointment, parsed by strtotime in the business or calendar timezone. Example: "2026-06-30T10:00:00+0300"

certificate.description: Package or coupon certificate code. Example: "ABC123"

notes.description: Appointment notes. Only settable when booking as an admin.

addonIDs.description: IDs of addons to include in the appointment. Example: [1]

labels.description: Label objects to apply to the appointment. Currently only accepts an array of length 1.

smsOptIn.description: Indicates whether the client has explicitly given permission to receive SMS messages.

admin.description: Pass true to disable availability and validation checks. Requires calendarID.

noEmail.description: Pass true to skip sending confirmation emails.

start.description: Start time of the block. Example: "2026-07-15T09:00:00+0300"

end.description: End time of the block. Example: "2026-07-15T10:00:00+0300"

calendarID.description: Calendar ID for the block. Example: 14209019

actions.description: Create a package or gift certificate.
actions.name: create-certificate

productID.description: The package ID to create a certificate for. Example: 2231275

couponID.description: The coupon ID to create a certificate for.

certificate.description: Custom certificate code. Auto-generated if omitted. Example: "NANGO-TEST-001"

email.description: Email address to assign the certificate to. Example: "bob.mctest@example.com"

orderID.description: Associated order ID, null if created via API.

id.description: The ID of the block to delete. Example: 1234

actions.description: Retrieve payment transactions for an appointment.
actions.name: get-appointment-payments

actions.description: Retrieve the authenticated user's account information.
actions.name: get-me

actions.description: List available add-ons for appointment types.
actions.name: list-appointment-addons

includeDeleted.description: Also include deleted appointment types in the response.

minDate.description: Only get appointments on this date and after

maxDate.description: Only get appointments on this date and before

calendarID.description: Show only appointments on calendar with specified ID

appointmentTypeID.description: Show only appointments of this type

firstName.description: Filter appointments for client first name

lastName.description: Filter appointments for client last name

email.description: Filter appointments for client e-mail address

phone.description: Filter appointments for client phone number

fieldId.description: Filter appointments matching a particular custom intake form field

excludeForms.description: Do not include intake forms in the response. Default: false

direction.description: Sort direction: ASC or DESC. Default: DESC

appointmentTypeID.description: Appointment type ID to filter by.

timezone.description: Timezone for availability time conversion (e.g., America/New_York).

minDate.description: Earliest date to return classes for.

maxDate.description: Latest date to return classes for.

includeUnavailable.description: Include classes that are no longer available.

actions.description: List dates with availability for a month and appointment type.
actions.name: list-availability-dates

month.description: Month to check available dates. Example: "2026-06"

appointmentTypeID.description: Numeric ID of the appointment type to check availability for. Example: 94517100

calendarID.description: Numeric ID of the calendar to check availability for.

addonIDs.description: Addon IDs to use when calculating availability.

timezone.description: Timezone for availability time conversion. Example: "America/New_York"

dates.description: Array of available date strings in YYYY-MM-DD format.

actions.description: List available times for a date and appointment type.
actions.name: list-availability-times

date.description: Date to check availability for. Example: "2026-06-15"

appointmentTypeID.description: Appointment type ID to check availability for. Example: 94517100

calendarID.description: Calendar ID to filter availability by. Example: 14209019

addonIDs.description: Array of addon IDs to include in availability check.

timezone.description: Timezone to use for the returned times. Example: "Indian/Mayotte"

ignoreAppointmentIDs.description: Array of appointment IDs to ignore when checking availability (useful for rescheduling).

minDate.description: Only get blocks this date and after (YYYY-MM-DD).

maxDate.description: Only get blocks this date and before (YYYY-MM-DD).

calendarID.description: Only get blocks on calendar with this ID.

productID.description: Get certificate codes for a particular product.

orderID.description: Get certificate codes for a particular order.

appointmentTypeID.description: Get certificate codes for a particular appointment type.

email.description: Get valid codes for a particular email address.

search.description: Search filter by first name, last name, or phone.

deleted.description: Include deleted products. Defaults to false.

datetime.description: New datetime for the appointment. Example: "2026-06-25T15:00:00+0300"

calendarID.description: Calendar ID. Omit or pass null for auto-select.

id.description: The appointment ID as a stable string
